//: Incremental type-checking harness (remediation Phase 3). No emit — esbuild/Vite still transpiles, so this is type-checking only. Adoption is OPT-IN: checkJs is false, so only files with a `// @ts-check` pragma (plus the shared *.d.ts contracts) are checked. This keeps `npm run typecheck` green from day one; ratchet coverage by adding `// @ts-check` to a module once it is clean, then eventually flip checkJs to true. Start with the pure simulation core + network protocol + event buses, where the snapshot/event shape-drift risk is highest.
